basic_info.description: Amazing opportunity in SOMA! Beautiful and well maintained 1 bed/1.5 bath condo perfect for first time buyers and investors alike. Step into the foyer and you are greeted by a ground level that is perfect for use an office or flex space. Additional half bath with in unit laundry complete the lower level. Upstairs you will find an open concept living area complete with modern kitchen, living/dining room and additional full bath with shower over tub. Stainless steel appliances including Bertazzoni range and Fisher Paykel fridge along with lots of counter space and pantry for additional storage. Connected to the main level is a beautiful private balcony with large glass doors and windows that bathe the unit in natural light. Perfect for a morning cup of coffee or evening glass of wine. Off the main living area is a spacious bedroom large enough for king bed and generous size closet. Low HOA dues with 1 car deeded parking included. Central location within walking distance to Downtown, Union Square, Financial District, SFMOMA, Yerba Buena Gardens, Ferry Building, and Oracle Ballpark. Easy access to public transit (BART or MUNI) making it easy to get anywhere in the city with ease. Right in the middle of a dynamic, convenient and culturally rich part of San Francisco.
